notes: ruling asked: the report opens with a passive «وَ ذُكِرَ اَلْمَاءُ» and places the Imam with «عِنْدَ اَلصَّادِقِ»; no transmitter is written, and the Imam's saying is the only speech, so the single link is the Imam (rule 10 shape). Whether this is a source or only the scene is not settled by the rules
«عند» is a place (rule 6), so the Imam is read from the saying, not from the place
